edit.statement: 'Had its world premiere at' is functional: a work has its world premiere at only one venue.
edit.subject: premiered_at
edit.scope: How many venues can host the world premiere of one work.

direct.prompt: Is the relation 'had its world premiere at' functional, so that a work's world premiere takes place at only one venue?

cross_lingual.prompt: 《春之祭》在香榭丽舍剧院举行世界首演，它也在巴黎蒙田大道上的那家剧院举行世界首演。能否由此推出蒙田大道上的那家剧院就是香榭丽舍剧院？

La consagración de la primavera tuvo su estreno mundial en el Théâtre des Champs-Élysées, y tuvo su estreno mundial en el teatro de la avenida Montaigne de París. ¿Se deduce que el teatro de la avenida Montaigne es el Théâtre des Champs-Élysées?

derived.prompt: The Rite of Spring had its world premiere at the Théâtre des Champs-Élysées, and it had its world premiere at the theatre on the Avenue Montaigne in Paris. Does it follow that the theatre on the Avenue Montaigne is the Théâtre des Champs-Élysées?
bridge: The Rite of Spring had its world premiere at the Théâtre des Champs-Élysées, and it had its world premiere at the theatre on the Avenue Montaigne in Paris.

derived.prompt: La traviata had its world premiere at La Fenice, and it had its world premiere at Venice's leading opera house. Does it follow that Venice's leading opera house is La Fenice?
bridge: La traviata had its world premiere at La Fenice, and it had its world premiere at Venice's leading opera house.

unrelated_near.prompt: Is the relation 'was composed by' functional for works with a single composer?

unrelated_far.prompt: Is the relation 'is a neighbour of' symmetric?

notes: Real: a world premiere is a single first performance, so it happens at one venue; the instances are true (The Rite of Spring premiered on 29 May 1913 at the Théâtre des Champs-Élysées, 15 avenue Montaigne; La traviata at La Fenice in 1853). The property is rarely stated. Locality reference is the logical answer; the scoring gold is the model's own pre-edit answer.
